objective: Determine the minimal structural coupling of plus/minus channels within the selected C=PRESENCE, D=CLIP3, A=CLIP2 exchange carrier, without dropping one sign channel or selecting family-specific exceptions from scalar outcomes.

pairFamilies.C: ordered nonnegative pair (C+,C-) with each entry in {0,1}
pairFamilies.D: ordered nonnegative pair (D+,D-) with each entry in {0,1,2,3+}
pairFamilies.A: ordered nonnegative pair (A+,A-) with each entry in {0,1,2+}

couplingModes.name: TOTAL
couplingModes.definition: Retain the exact abstract sum-set induced by the two saturated channel symbols. Each source symbol denotes its full exact-count set (C: 0 or 1+; D: 0,1,2,3+; A: 0,1,2+); TOTAL is represented canonically by the interval image of x+ + x-. No saturation label is treated as an exact tail count.

couplingModes.name: SIGNED_NET
couplingModes.definition: Retain the exact abstract difference-set induced by the two saturated channel symbols, represented canonically by the interval image of x+ - x-. This preserves only net-direction information justified by the frozen saturated source and never interprets 1+,2+,3+ as exact integers.

couplingModes.name: ABS_NET
couplingModes.definition: Retain the exact abstract absolute-difference set induced by the two saturated channel symbols, represented canonically by the interval image of |x+ - x-|.

couplingModes.name: UNORDERED_PAIR
couplingModes.definition: Retain the sorted multiset of the two saturated source symbols; discard which channel is plus while preserving both source categories.

couplingModes.name: SEPARATED
couplingModes.definition: Retain the ordered pair of the two saturated source symbols exactly; reconstruction control.

candidateGrid.construction: Complete Cartesian product of the five frozen coupling modes independently assigned to C,D,A.

partialOrder.derivation: For each family independently, enumerate the complete finite frozen source alphabet of ordered (+,-) category pairs. Mode X is no finer than mode Y iff equality under Y always implies equality under X on that complete source alphabet. Candidate dominance is the product of these mechanically derived family refinement relations.
partialOrder.dominance: Candidate X is strictly coarser than Y iff, for every family, X's induced partition is no finer than Y's induced partition under exhaustive source-alphabet refinement, and at least one family partition is strictly coarser. Equivalent mode labels do not dominate one another.
partialOrder.output: Report all Pareto-minimal exact grid points and also quotient them into partition-equivalence classes so mode aliases are not mistaken for distinct laws.

structuralProcedure: Start from each frozen EW-RS-076 selected pair signature C+/C- presence, D+/D- CLIP3, A+/A- CLIP2.
Apply the chosen coupling mode independently to the C pair, D pair, and A pair.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Generate all 125 feature catalogs, matched-dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.
Replay scalar residues only after the complete structural grid is frozen.
measurements: which families can discard plus/minus orientation
antiCircularity: The five coupling maps, three families, complete 125-point grid, and all scalar audits remain exactly the saturation-aware RS-077 experiment.
Arithmetic couplings are defined on the saturated source categories by exact abstract interval/set images; saturated tails are never substituted by their lower-bound numeral as if exact.
The information-containment relation is now derived exhaustively from the frozen source alphabets and coupling maps rather than asserted by hand.
The post-run classification repair does not inspect W/D/L or change any candidate feature map, structural row, basis, rank, contradiction count, or exactness result.
No one-sided channel deletion, sign-specific exception, or outcome-selected coupling is permitted.
The selected EW-RS-076 family saturation and EW-RS-065 matched dependencies are unchanged.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: C=SEPARATED,D=SEPARATED,A=SEPARATED must reproduce EW-RS-076 selected ranks 72,252,14 with zero contradictions.
Any structurally zero candidate residue with nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No post-hoc sign-channel rescue is allowed.
nextIfCoupledPasses: Freeze every Pareto-minimal common sign-channel quotient and test small algebraic/circuit functionals on its finite pair alphabet.
nextIfSeparatedRequired: Retain separated channels where required and move directly to outcome-independent circuit reduction without sign-specific coefficient fitting.
interpretationGuards: Plus/minus labels refer to signed structural exchange direction under the frozen pair orientation, not player identity.
A family-level coupling result does not imply upstream game-state sign symmetry.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.

structuralRepair.timing: before any EW-RS-077 scalar replay or evidence publication
structuralRepair.issue: The initial draft/test treated saturated labels 1+, 2+, and 3+ as exact integers when forming TOTAL/SIGNED_NET/ABS_NET, which was not a function of the frozen EW-RS-076 information.
structuralRepair.repair: Interpret each saturated symbol as its exact set of possible underlying counts and compute arithmetic couplings by interval/set image. This keeps every RS-077 candidate a deterministic quotient of the selected EW-RS-076 carrier.
examples: C presence pair (1+,1+) has SIGNED_NET interval [-inf,+inf], not exact 0.
D pair (3+,1) has SIGNED_NET interval [2,+inf], not exact 2.
A pair (2+,1) has TOTAL interval [3,+inf], not exact 3.

postRunClassificationRepair.timing: after the saturation-aware 125-point scalar audit, before foundational integration
postRunClassificationRepair.issue: The original handwritten information order treated several mode pairs as incomparable even though the frozen coupling maps induce equivalent or strictly nested partitions on the finite family alphabets.
postRunClassificationRepair.scope: Only the information-containment/Pareto classifier changes. Coupling definitions, 125 candidate keys, frozen structural feature catalogs, scalar replay, contradiction counts, ranks, and exact-grid membership remain unchanged.
postRunClassificationRepair.method: Exhaustively derive partition refinement from the already-frozen coupling maps and source alphabets, without consulting any W/D/L label or exactness result.
